verdict.rationale: Cursor documents and live-verifies a public, key-gated Cloud Agents API (endpoints, OpenAPI spec, webhooks), an Admin/Analytics/AI Code Tracking API, an Origin public API, and official TypeScript/Python SDKs, plus a scriptable CLI with structured JSON output for CI/automation — this is a broad, documented, independently-probed public API surface. missing for 10: no independent third-party developer report of building against these APIs beyond Cursor's own docs/probes.
